# TeamADAPT Database Inventory

**Last Updated:** 2025-12-14  
**Owner:** DataOps Team  
**Purpose:** Comprehensive inventory of all databases and data systems

---

## Database Categories

### 1. Production Databases

#### Core Application Databases
| Database Name | Type | Purpose | Environment | Status |
|---------------|------|---------|-------------|---------|
| adapt_core_prod | PostgreSQL 14.x | Primary application data | Production | Active |
| adapt_auth_prod | PostgreSQL 14.x | Authentication & user management | Production | Active |
| adapt_analytics_prod | PostgreSQL 14.x | Analytics and reporting data | Production | Active |
| adapt_cache_prod | Redis 7.x | Session storage & caching | Production | Active |

#### Data Warehouse
| Database Name | Type | Purpose | Environment | Status |
|---------------|------|---------|-------------|---------|
| adapt_dw_prod | Snowflake | Enterprise data warehouse | Production | Active |
| adapt_dw_staging | Snowflake | Data staging environment | Production | Active |

### 2. Development/Test Databases

| Database Name | Type | Purpose | Environment | Status |
|---------------|------|---------|-------------|---------|
| adapt_core_dev | PostgreSQL 14.x | Development testing | Development | Active |
| adapt_core_test | PostgreSQL 14.x | Automated testing | CI/CD | Active |
| adapt_analytics_dev | PostgreSQL 14.x | Analytics development | Development | Active |

### 3. Data Integration Systems

| System Name | Type | Purpose | Environment | Status |
|-------------|------|---------|-------------|---------|
| adapt_etl_prod | Apache Airflow | ETL orchestration | Production | Active |
| adapt_api_prod | REST API Gateway | External data integration | Production | Active |
| adapt_stream_prod | Apache Kafka | Real-time data streaming | Production | Active |

---

## Connection Details

### Production Connection Templates
```
# PostgreSQL Connection String Template
postgresql://username:password@host:5432/database_name

# Redis Connection Template  
redis://username:password@host:6379/0

# Snowflake Connection Template
snowflake://username:password@account_identifier/database_name/schema_name
```

### Security Requirements
- All production databases require SSL/TLS encryption
- Use connection pooling (PgBouncer for PostgreSQL)
- Implement proper role-based access control
- Regular password rotation (90 days)
- Audit logging enabled for all connections

---

## Monitoring & Health Checks

### Key Metrics to Monitor
- Connection count and pool utilization
- Query performance and slow query detection
- Storage utilization and growth trends
- Replication lag (if applicable)
- Backup completion and restore testing

### Alert Thresholds
- **Connection Pool:** >80% utilization
- **Disk Usage:** >85% capacity
- **Query Performance:** >5 seconds average
- **Failed Connections:** >5% of total attempts

---

## Backup & Recovery

### Backup Strategy
- **PostgreSQL:** Daily full backups + WAL archiving
- **Redis:** RDB snapshots every 6 hours
- **Snowflake:** Time travel (7 days) + Fail-safe (90 days)

### Recovery Objectives
- **RTO (Recovery Time Objective):** 4 hours
- **RPO (Recovery Point Objective):** 1 hour

---

## Data Governance

### Data Classification
- **Confidential:** User authentication data, PII
- **Internal:** Application business data
- **Public:** Analytics aggregates, metrics

### Compliance Requirements
- GDPR compliance for user data
- SOC 2 Type II for production systems
- Regular security audits (quarterly)

---

## Change Management

### Deployment Process
1. Schema changes approved by DataOps Lead
2. Tested in development environment
3. Staged deployment with rollback plan
4. Production deployment during maintenance windows
5. Post-deployment validation and monitoring

---

## Contact Information

**DataOps Lead:** spine@teamadapt.internal  
**DBA Team:** dba@teamadapt.internal  
**On-Call:** dataops-oncall@teamadapt.internal

---

*This inventory is maintained automatically and updated on schema changes*
[END_FILE]
